roomposition-find-closest-by-path-range-.actual: Stable vanilla's `_findClosestByPath2` (`@screeps/engine/src/game/rooms.js:304-374`) never reads `opts.range`: it hardcodes `{range: 1, pos: i}` on the PathFinder goal at line 328 and post-filters reachability with `lastPos.isNearTo(obj)` at line 368.
roomposition-find-closest-by-path-range-.expected: RoomPosition.findClosestByPath uses opts.range as the goal range when deciding reachability.
roomposition-find-closest-by-path-range-.why: Canonical claim is PR-derived: screeps/engine#121 (open, enhancement/needs-testing) proposes honoring the range option (#136 is a closed duplicate). Stable vanilla has not shipped it, so this row is an expected failure on BOTH adapters until upstream lands — it is not an xxscreeps bug.

The reusable-cache branch (`creeps.js:241-302`) then calls `moveByPath` → `move` (which returns `ERR_TIRED`) and falls through to `findPathTo` at line 283, which re-invokes the supplied `costCallback`.
movecache-fatigue-visualization-recomput.expected: A fatigued moveTo call with a valid reusable path and visualizePathStyle returns ERR_TIRED without recomputing a path.
movecache-fatigue-visualization-recomput.why: Canonical claim is PR-derived: screeps/engine#152 (open) stops moveTo recomputing a path when the creep is fatigued, visualizePathStyle is set, and a valid memorized path exists. xxscreeps already implements it; vanilla stays expected-fail until upstream lands.
